artifact: CityMETER Office — 3D-first, district-first map of office records across Thailand (organisation premises, rental offices and managed workspaces), with the median of listed starting asking rents per area, rail context from the same registry, organisations and a rent comparison set per office

firstAha: count: share of the leading province’s offices that sit in its top districts (≤ 3, a tie at the cut joins while ≤ 4 and one district stays out; never every district holding offices), the share within 500 m of an operating rail station there against the rest of the province (rows with a point; both bases), and the district with the most outside it; rent: the leading province’s districts with the highest median dated asking rent (n ≥ 5, each with its n), the province’s median, the medians within 500 m of rail and farther (each n), and the highest median outside it; computed per selection; the map opens in the 3D city preset with those districts focused automatically and the rest quiet
countingUnit: measure switch: offices (แห่ง, default; Office IDs, never buildings) or the median of dated starting asking rents (บาท/ตร.ม./เดือน, from 5 rents); undated rents and legacy prices per office only

focusAndQuiet.implementation: app.js focus modes (auto/explicit/none) and row scopes; map-layers.js filled/quiet/province feature-state; pins.js cue symbols vs grey context dots; massing.js quiet city tier vs rounded focus tier, see-through front buildings in the building view (setScene eye); venue-xray.js draws the building being looked at over everything else; stations.js quiet station rings and the selected station radius; camera.js presets and the building view (fitBuilding, twoPointBearing); provinces.js frames below zoom 8 without a จังหวัด filter

geometryAndMetricContract: one row per symbol, only rows with a point; membership = production district matched at build time (row.admin: name · point · province · conflict); offices are totals, rents are medians with n; outlines per province on demand
accessibility: visible focus on every control including pins, area labels and chart marks
keyboard pin tour (arrow keys) at detail zoom, excluding quiet context dots
roving tablist for the chart views
table equivalent for every map view
categorical shape cues beside colour; text labels in every legend and list
empty, map-failure, frame-failure and load-error paths with actions
Thai labels for the map’s own controls (MapLibre locale)
measure switch (สำนักงาน | ค่าเช่า) as a radio group (arrow keys), its state announced

validation.renderedHarness: Playwright + MapLibre 5.6.2 from the npm package; OpenFreeMap, unpkg, DEM and CityMETER building tiles stubbed in the build container (no basemap, no buildings there); 1440×900 and 393×852, light and dark; live walk on GitHub Pages for the real basemap
validation.scope: Applied LDS values, fonts and actual rendered interfaces. No blanket LDS, CVD, native-device or market-completeness claim.

layoutContract.mobilePortrait: full map, five toolbar buttons in one row (วิธีใช้ and Product statement at the top of the sheet); 0.3.5 (owner 2026-11-02 “ในมือถือ เหลือพื้นที่ map น้อยมาก ช่วยปรับปรุงด้วย”): one compact dock at the foot of the map — the Aha finding in two lines with its action, over one legend row (measure switch | level + zero swatch over the 41-sample ramp) — above the attribution while it is open, dropped to the tray once it folds to its (i) button; zoom buttons off on touch phones (pinch; the compass stays); bottom sheet 56% of the screen with a sticky close, opening on the office, building, station or area (the dataset heading and search return with the overview)

mapContract.basemap: generated at runtime by js/shell/map-style.js on https://tiles.openfreemap.org/planet with --basemap-* tokens
mapContract.choropleth: count (offices) or price (median dated asking rent), all 41 samples by rank over the measured values; beneath the basemap’s first line layer; zoom 8–14.5 (8–12.5 in terrain mode, hard switch), the selected จังหวัด from zoom 4; EVID-05 measured / measured_zero (count: sample 0 + 2 px zero outline) / no_data (rent: < 5 dated rents, hatch) / out_of_scope (rent: no office, bare)
mapContract.provinces: the same measure per province frame below zoom 8 without a จังหวัด filter (rent: hatch where < 5 dated rents), outlines to zoom 12, ink-chip labels to zoom 9, panel list
mapContract.symbols: focus rows with a point as cue icons at one size for every office; context rows as grey circles ≤ 6 px radius; HTML pins from zoom 15.5; the pin label is office name · floors · asking rent; stations of CityMETER Transit as quiet clickable rings from zoom 10.5, names from 13.5
mapContract.buildings: per อปท. (Bangkok: เขต): CityMETER Building V4 where it holds ≥ 1.15 × the OSM buildings of the unit, else OSM (data/building-units/); OSM buildings mapped in parts kept; same quiet massing tones and rounded shape for both sources; the attribution names CityMETER Building V4 while drawn
mapContract.buildingView: eye preset corner-on to the building on the least-occluded diagonal, zoom to fit the free part of the map on every way in (js/shell/camera.js#fitBuilding); a station frames its 500 m radius; every office with a point opens it — the building its pin falls in, else the drawn building nearest the pin within 300 m (800 m after one widen) with the pin in the frame (legend “อาคารใกล้หมุด”); choosing an office or a building switches the map to 3D
mapContract.breadcrumb: ประเทศไทย › จังหวัด › เขต/อำเภอ with production codes and /D/ deep links, ?d=office
mapContract.symbolSize: one size for every office (js/model.js#pinRadius): an Office ID can be a few floors or a tower, so no record is drawn larger than another; quiet context ≤ 6 px radius
mapContract.labels: from zoom 12.5: ≤ 9 (phone 5) labels in the central ellipse ranked by floors + asking-rent percentiles; text only — category cue, short name (leading “อาคาร” and place words dropped), price pictogram + starting asking rent; measured placement off the chrome and the district chips (js/labels.js)
mapContract.terrain: terrain mode at hilly sites (zoom ≥ 12.5, 3D, relief ≥ 30 m in view) and round a building or office being looked at: 3D ground × 1.5 + hillshade in basemap tones; the district fill switches off at 12.5 (hard switch); buildings, the x-ray and the building camera stand on the drawn ground (js/shell/terrain.js, js/shell/camera.js) — carried from Hotel 0.3.0
mapContract.iconFirstText: district chips carry the measure pictogram, the status is a pin + number, legend items are a symbol + 1–2 words; sentences live in titles and accessible names (owner 2026-11-01)
mapContract.water: light water --basemap-water #CFDDE7 (basemap-only, 1.22:1 from the ground) with the water-shore line --basemap-shore #B2C7D6 above the district fill; dark keeps surface.blueTint #18333E (0.3.4, owner “ใน light theme ทำให้ทะเล/water body ดูเหมือนน้ำมากกว่านี้ … แต่ยัง clean and quiet”); the coast line, district outlines and legend separate the sea from low li.supply classes, never the water hue alone
